operational_simulation.organization_and_actor: Brazilian omnichannel retailer or marketplace; customer-service operations manager, fulfillment-exception supervisor, and catalog-governance analyst
processes: predict fulfillment exceptions before the promised date
classify product listings and catalog-quality defects
deterministic_baselines: queue routing by category, seller, order state, and consumer-rights rules

training_data.observation_unit: one complaint, order checkpoint, or product-listing review at a defined decision time
training_data.input_data: order and carrier events, promised date, seller and SKU attributes, contact reason, catalog fields, and only information available before prediction
training_data.target_or_reward: confirmed complaint category, later delivery failure, or specialist-confirmed catalog defect
training_data.label_source: closed service cases, final delivery outcomes, refunds and cancellations, and catalog-review corrections
training_data.prediction_time: case intake, pre-breach fulfillment checkpoint, or listing submission
training_data.expected_volume: unknown; must be measured per retailer and target task
training_data.class_balance: unknown; severe delivery failures and some catalog defects are likely minority classes
training_data.historical_coverage: unknown; depends on stable category definitions and retained event history
training_data.train_validation_split: time-based split with seller, SKU, campaign, and peak-season leakage controls
training_data.leakage_risks: using final carrier status, refund, cancellation, resolution category, post-review edits, or fields created after escalation
training_data.representativeness_risks: Black Friday peaks, new sellers, new SKUs, regional carriers, changing catalog taxonomies, and historical routing policy
training_data.feedback_loop: agent corrections, final order outcome, consumer resolution, and catalog-governance approval
training_data.privacy_and_usage_constraints: minimize consumer and seller identifiers; restrict customer-service text and decision-impacting features
training_data.fallback_if_data_is_insufficient: retain deterministic SLA, schema validation, carrier alerts, and human triage; collect prospective labels before training

portfolio_coherence.reason: The remaining candidates either overlap existing repository cases or mature case-categorization, catalog-enrichment, and fulfillment-management capabilities. No distinct actor-process-capability-outcome gap remained.

notes: Custom training was seriously investigated and rejected without forcing publication.
